high_level_description: The image depicts a person dressed in a Minnie Mouse costume, standing outdoors at night. The individual is wearing a black strapless top with a pink bow on the left side, a pink skirt adorned with white polka dots, and black knee-high boots. They also have a large pink bow on their head, resembling Minnie Mouse's iconic accessory, along with black ears that match the bow. In the background, there are other people, some of whom appear to be dressed up as well, suggesting that this might be a Halloween party or a themed event.
